organization: Two fixed ideas and controls, separate numbered run directories, immutable executed script snapshots, final_info.json and experiment notes; local execution by Codex subagents. No native launcher.

run_1.question: 同一随机链后选择停 S、随机再问一次 U 或主动再问一次 T，哪种选择的执行损失更低？
run_1.prediction: R(T)-R(U)>0，额外错改的贡献至少与少纠正一样大。
run_1.primary: R(T)-R(U), lower is better for T
secondary: D_harm and D_missed, raw benefit/harm and decision flips
hit, actual logical reads, per-task, leave-one-task-out, ties/invalid/identical edge diagnostics, pool range and raw utility gains
run_1.protocol: research/selection-study-v1/proposal.md §§D1、门槛与转向，含优先级。strictly match prefixes, project clean trace fields, seal selections before evaluating labels.
run_1.stop: D1 only this wave; record the decision on D2 using the reviewed gates.

run_2.question: 同样的完整随机补问赛程、弃权和汇总，替换被裁判判反的有效胜者后，所选代码能改善多少？
run_2.prediction: 替换后任务等权损失更低。
run_2.schedule: Use complete coverage_random traces only: chain followed by uniformly sampled unseen pairs; schedule independent of winning directions. Keep observed endpoint order, all original abstentions, actual unique costs and frozen aggregation. For true score ties retain original direction.
arms: evaluator-only: all valid strict direction errors corrected by existing execution labels on already queried edges; keep valid ties as recorded
run_2.primary: mean task regret(original) - regret(corrected); positive = potential gain on this fixed graph, not a feasible policy or theoretical bound
secondary: per-task paired changes, task bootstrap 95%, corrected residual regret, improved/equal/worsened episodes, frequency of valid errors and set changes, paired best hit
predefined cases: first by frozen job order among improved and worsened, optional unchanged; describe without generalizing
run_2.stop: One evaluator-side counterfactual, no sweep or live judge; no policy or scoring-contract edits. Residual may combine missing edges, abstention and aggregation.

resources.runs: one successful run per question, preserve any failed attempts; independent audit may recompute in temp

analysis_scope: Fixed previously inspected development bank; clusters are tasks. Two separately prespecified diagnostic questions, descriptive intervals; no claim of confirmation or ranking the two different estimands.
